Roope Hintz has 19 points in 20 games and is riding a four-game point streak, and he's doing it in only 16.5 minutes a night. His 3.46 points per hour sit well above his 2.87 last season, which was cut to 53 games.

Some of it is bounces. He's shooting 21.6% against a league norm of 13.3%, and his teammates have scored 3.28 more goals than expected with him on. But the base is solid: at five on five the Stars have had 55.58% of the expected goals with him on, 4.91 points better than without him, and his goals rank 38th of 530 skaters in wins added.

He's built for the rush. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 63% of his entries last season, and his speed bursts sit in the 98th percentile by NHL EDGE. Evolving-Hockey rated him worth 2.8 wins last season, 20th among forwards, with elite defensive impact. Watch the minutes: he's producing like a first-liner on second-line ice time.
headline: Roope Hintz is scoring at a career clip
